verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents traces that capture every LLM and non-LLM step (retrieval, tool, and API calls) within a request. It groups multi-turn conversations into sessions and visualizes agentic workflows as graphs. Community users confirm they rely on it for tracing complex LLM pipelines, though one notes that retries clutter traces and are not collapsible. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the nested span/observation hierarchy, and docs showing how multi-step agent runs map into sessions or threads.
